data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: awesome-agent-skills
data_tooling.summary: Awesome Agent Skills 是一个精心整理的AI智能体技能库，汇集了1000多个来自官方团队和社区的现成能力模块，帮助开发者快速构建功能丰富的AI助手而无需从头开发。该项目通过系统化分类整理技能，兼容Claude Code、Gemini CLI等主流平台，展示了如何通过模块化设计实现智能体能力的灵活扩展。开发者可以浏览这些技能，学习其实现思路，并直接集成到自己的项目中，用于代码生成、内容创作等场景，有效提升开发效率并激发新的应用灵感。
data_tooling.summary_en: Awesome Agent Skills is a curated repository of over 1,000 ready-to-use AI agent capabilities that helps developers quickly enhance their AI assistants without building from scratch. It organizes skills from both official teams and community contributions into a structured collection compatible with major platforms like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. Developers can browse, adapt, and integrate these skills into their projects to create more capable agents for tasks ranging from code generation to creative writing, accelerating development through shared expertise.

data_tooling.name: claude-context
data_tooling.summary: Claude-context 是一个代码搜索工具，专为AI编程助手设计，通过将整个代码库转化为可查询的上下文，解决了传统代码助手只能处理片段代码的局限。它基于Model Context Protocol（MCP）构建，利用嵌入向量和Merkle树技术索引代码库，既能实现语义搜索，又能保持代码结构完整性。开发者可将其集成到Claude Desktop或自定义代理中，通过自然语言查询快速导航大型项目、理解陌生代码，或为AI助手提供全面的代码背景支持，提升编程效率。
data_tooling.summary_en: Claude-context is a code search tool that enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code to access and understand entire codebases, solving the context limitation problem where agents typically only see small code snippets. It works as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that indexes repositories using embeddings and Merkle trees, allowing semantic search across all files while maintaining structural integrity. Developers can integrate it with Claude Desktop or build custom agents to query codebases naturally, making it practical for navigating large projects or understanding unfamiliar code through conversational interfaces.

edge_embedded.name: YTLite
edge_embedded.summary: YTLite 是一款开源 iOS 增强工具，通过直接修改 YouTube 应用的行为，解决广告干扰和播放限制等问题，将其转变为高度可定制的观看平台。它基于 Logos 开发，以代码注入方式运行，无需独立应用即可实现功能扩展，展示了移动端应用层优化的灵活技术路径。用户可借此实验广告屏蔽、SponsorBlock 集成或后台播放等功能，适合开发者学习应用逆向工程，或普通用户打造个性化媒体体验。
edge_embedded.summary_en: YTLite is an open-source iOS enhancement tool that transforms the standard YouTube app into a more customizable viewing experience, addressing limitations like intrusive ads and restricted playback options. It operates as a tweak built with Logos, injecting code directly into the YouTube app to modify its behavior without requiring a separate application. Developers and users can apply it to enable features like ad-blocking, SponsorBlock integration, and background playback, making it ideal for experimenting with mobile app modifications or creating personalized media interfaces.

ui_devex.name: ai-agents-for-beginners
ui_devex.summary: AI Agents for Beginners 是一个面向初学者的实践教育项目，通过12节Jupyter Notebook课程系统介绍如何构建能够自主推理和执行任务的AI智能体。它采用“智能体框架+RAG”的核心架构，让开发者理解如何让多个专业智能体协同工作以处理复杂流程。学习者可以跟随课程动手创建自己的智能体，应用于自动化研究助手、客户服务机器人或数据分析管道等场景，掌握从基础概念到实际部署的完整技能链。
ui_devex.summary_en: AI Agents for Beginners is a practical educational resource that introduces developers to building autonomous AI systems capable of reasoning and executing tasks. It teaches core concepts like agentic frameworks and RAG through hands-on Jupyter Notebook lessons, demonstrating how to orchestrate multiple specialized agents for complex workflows. Developers can use this repository to create their own agents for applications like automated research assistants, customer service bots, or data analysis pipelines by following the structured curriculum.

ui_devex.name: RAG-Anything
ui_devex.summary: RAG-Anything 是一个一体化检索增强生成框架，旨在简化多模态数据与大型语言模型的集成难题。它通过统一架构支持文本、图像和音频等多种数据类型，使用单一流程实现跨模态的检索与生成，降低了开发复杂度。该框架允许用户灵活配置数据加载器和嵌入模型，快速构建定制化应用，例如文档问答或多媒体内容分析系统。其设计突出了模块化和扩展性，让开发者能专注于业务逻辑而非底层实现，适合需要处理混合数据源的智能应用场景。
ui_devex.summary_en: RAG-Anything is an all-in-one framework that simplifies building retrieval-augmented generation systems, addressing the challenge of integrating diverse data sources with large language models. Its key innovation is a unified architecture supporting multiple modalities—text, images, and audio—through a single pipeline, enabling consistent retrieval and generation across data types. Developers can use it to create custom RAG applications by configuring data loaders and embedding models, then deploy the system for tasks like document Q&A or multimedia content analysis with minimal setup overhead.

ui_devex.name: YTLite
ui_devex.summary: YTLite 是一款开源 iOS 增强工具，通过直接修改 YouTube 应用的行为，解决广告干扰和播放限制等问题，将其转变为高度可定制的观看平台。它基于 Logos 开发，以代码注入方式运行，无需独立应用即可实现功能扩展，展示了移动端应用层优化的灵活技术路径。用户可借此实验广告屏蔽、SponsorBlock 集成或后台播放等功能，适合开发者学习应用逆向工程，或普通用户打造个性化媒体体验。
ui_devex.summary_en: YTLite is an open-source iOS enhancement tool that transforms the standard YouTube app into a more customizable viewing experience, addressing limitations like intrusive ads and restricted playback options. It operates as a tweak built with Logos, injecting code directly into the YouTube app to modify its behavior without requiring a separate application. Developers and users can apply it to enable features like ad-blocking, SponsorBlock integration, and background playback, making it ideal for experimenting with mobile app modifications or creating personalized media interfaces.

agents_workflows.name: ai-agents-for-beginners
agents_workflows.summary: AI Agents for Beginners 是一个面向初学者的实践教育项目，通过12节Jupyter Notebook课程系统介绍如何构建能够自主推理和执行任务的AI智能体。它采用“智能体框架+RAG”的核心架构，让开发者理解如何让多个专业智能体协同工作以处理复杂流程。学习者可以跟随课程动手创建自己的智能体，应用于自动化研究助手、客户服务机器人或数据分析管道等场景，掌握从基础概念到实际部署的完整技能链。
agents_workflows.summary_en: AI Agents for Beginners is a practical educational resource that introduces developers to building autonomous AI systems capable of reasoning and executing tasks. It teaches core concepts like agentic frameworks and RAG through hands-on Jupyter Notebook lessons, demonstrating how to orchestrate multiple specialized agents for complex workflows. Developers can use this repository to create their own agents for applications like automated research assistants, customer service bots, or data analysis pipelines by following the structured curriculum.

agents_workflows.name: claude-context
agents_workflows.summary: Claude-context 是一个代码搜索工具，专为AI编程助手设计，通过将整个代码库转化为可查询的上下文，解决了传统代码助手只能处理片段代码的局限。它基于Model Context Protocol（MCP）构建，利用嵌入向量和Merkle树技术索引代码库，既能实现语义搜索，又能保持代码结构完整性。开发者可将其集成到Claude Desktop或自定义代理中，通过自然语言查询快速导航大型项目、理解陌生代码，或为AI助手提供全面的代码背景支持，提升编程效率。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Claude-context is a code search tool that enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code to access and understand entire codebases, solving the context limitation problem where agents typically only see small code snippets. It works as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that indexes repositories using embeddings and Merkle trees, allowing semantic search across all files while maintaining structural integrity. Developers can integrate it with Claude Desktop or build custom agents to query codebases naturally, making it practical for navigating large projects or understanding unfamiliar code through conversational interfaces.

deployment_serving.name: claude-context
deployment_serving.summary: Claude-context 是一个代码搜索工具，专为AI编程助手设计，通过将整个代码库转化为可查询的上下文，解决了传统代码助手只能处理片段代码的局限。它基于Model Context Protocol（MCP）构建，利用嵌入向量和Merkle树技术索引代码库，既能实现语义搜索，又能保持代码结构完整性。开发者可将其集成到Claude Desktop或自定义代理中，通过自然语言查询快速导航大型项目、理解陌生代码，或为AI助手提供全面的代码背景支持，提升编程效率。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Claude-context is a code search tool that enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code to access and understand entire codebases, solving the context limitation problem where agents typically only see small code snippets. It works as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that indexes repositories using embeddings and Merkle trees, allowing semantic search across all files while maintaining structural integrity. Developers can integrate it with Claude Desktop or build custom agents to query codebases naturally, making it practical for navigating large projects or understanding unfamiliar code through conversational interfaces.
